---
name: Request a teardown
about: Suggest something you want me to take apart and build against.
title: "teardown|<REPLACE WITH YOUR TOPIC>"
labels: teardown
---

Replace the part of the title after `teardown|` with what you want analysed —
a control, a cloud primitive, a protocol, a class of misconfiguration.

Anything after the pipe gets sanitised and added to the public queue on my
profile, then this issue closes itself. You do not need to write anything here.

Examples:

- `teardown|S3 bucket policy evaluation order`
- `teardown|OIDC trust in GitHub Actions`
- `teardown|SCIM provisioning failure modes`
